tasks.title: Protect Agent popovers from native Browser occlusion
tasks.objective: Route Agent avatar popover lifetime through the existing native-surface visibility contract.
tasks.outcome: The avatar detail remains readable across split Regions and all close paths restore Browser surfaces.
acceptance: Opening any AgentAvatar identity popover acquires one native-surface occlusion lease; repeated pointer movement does not double acquire.
Closing, blurring, pressing Escape, unmounting, or failing to open the popover releases the same lease.
Workspace Browser surfaces are hidden only while the lease is active and restore through their existing bounds synchronizer.
The existing tab/context menu occlusion behavior remains unchanged.

verification.ref: CI=true pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/agent-avatar.test.tsx test/workbench-browser-visibility.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Popover lifetime and native Browser visibility are coupled without leaks.
The occlusion contract is type safe through AgentAvatar, store, and workbench consumers.

tasks.title: Keep Browser content through transient resize geometry
tasks.objective: Treat zero-size ResizeObserver readings as layout transitions instead of Browser closure.
tasks.outcome: Window and pane resizing keeps the last valid Browser frame until the next valid bounds arrive.
acceptance: A zero or non-finite stage rectangle during an otherwise visible Browser resize does not call synchronizer.observe(null).
A later valid rectangle is applied normally and the Browser does not navigate, restore, or recreate its WebContentsView.
Explicit invisibility, parking, errors, screenshot/selection overlays, and cleanup still send null bounds.

verification.ref: CI=true pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/browser-bounds-sync.test.ts test/browser-pane-resize.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Transient geometry is deferred while explicit hide paths still hide the native Browser.
BrowserPane and geometry helper contracts compile.
